groups.name: frame
groups.summary: Inspect frame, scene and camera render state over a real observation window, and capture one or many frames to Assets/Docs~.

actions.name: inspect
actions.summary: Scene, play/pause, time scale, cameras with projection and clip planes, active render textures, and which cameras actually rendered.

actions.name: capture
actions.summary: Write one frame or a timed sequence from the project's Scene camera, a named camera, or the Scene view, plus a manifest.

observeMs.description: inspect: how long to watch real render callbacks. 0 skips observation entirely.

folder.description: capture: a single folder name under Assets/Docs~, given as <date>_<feature> (e.g. 0915_渲染分析). A bare feature name is auto-dated.

source.description: capture: all = scenecam + sceneview. scenecam/camera read an existing render texture; sceneview renders on demand.

camera.description: capture: camera name or instance id, required when source=camera.

prefix.description: capture: file name prefix. Must not contain a path separator or '..'.

count.description: capture: number of frames. Above 1 each frame is numbered.

intervalMs.description: capture: minimum wait between grabs. count-1 times this must not exceed 60000.

force.description: capture: overwrite existing PNGs and manifest instead of refusing.

groups.name: input
groups.summary: Inspect the pointer and the UI or world object under it, and synthesise mouse, key or scroll input.

actions.name: pointer-inspect
actions.summary: What is under the pointer: UI elements with a safe text summary, the Scene-view object, and a game-view physics hit.

actions.name: ui-pointer
actions.summary: Spelled the way the MCP contract spells it. Identical to pointer-inspect; both names stay registered so neither caller breaks.

actions.name: move
actions.summary: Move the pointer to a screen point.

actions.name: click
actions.summary: Press and release a mouse button at a screen point, across separate frames.

actions.name: drag
actions.summary: Press at a start point, move through waypoints, release.

actions.name: key
actions.summary: Press and release a key, as an Editor key event.

x.description: Screen X. Origin is bottom-left, matching Screen and Input coordinates.

y.description: Screen Y measured from the bottom.

points.description: drag: waypoints as {x,y} or [x,y]. Also accepts @file.json containing a 'points' array.

agent.description: Gesture attribution, as in the MCP contract. Accepted and echoed back on the response; it never changes behaviour.

key.description: key: a KeyCode or Event.KeyboardEvent name such as Space, Return, LeftShift, a.

backend.description: Which injection backend to use. auto prefers editor-event, and uses inputsystem in Play Mode when asked for explicitly.

targetWindow.description: editor-event: Editor window type or title to receive the event. Defaults to the focused window, or the active Scene view for pointer gestures.

holdFrames.description: Frames to hold a button down before releasing.

settleFrames.description: Frames to wait after injection so the target can react.

includeText.description: pointer-inspect: summarise text components. Always through the field allow-list.

groups.name: recorder
groups.summary: Run a resumable capture session: record frames to PNG, or drive the Unity Recorder package for video when it is installed.

actions.name: status
actions.summary: Read the session record; works after a domain reload or an Editor restart.

actions.name: start
actions.summary: Begin a session. Refuses if one is already recording.

actions.name: stop
actions.summary: End the active session, write its manifest and report the summary. Idempotent.

actions.name: frame
actions.summary: Capture exactly one frame now, inside the active session or on its own.

mode.description: auto picks frames and reports why; video needs the Unity Recorder package.

target.description: Camera name or instance id for source=game.

fps.description: video: frame rate for the Recorder.
